answer: Challenge-answer uniqueness audit resists sybils: the system hashes every submitted answer and rejects near-duplicates across identities within and across epochs, so a ring cannot mass-produce one relic template across its members. An orchard of fakes submitting lightly-varied copies is caught by the similarity check, their shared trellis of phrasing exposed. Each identity must produce genuinely distinct work, which a single operator behind many accounts cannot scale.
